summary: Wood challenges naturalism's warrant for abstract cognition; Aron Ra defends provisional, publicly corrected inquiry while requiring objective evidence for supernatural additions.

con-known-world-not-universal-negative.words: Accepting the known physical world does not entail denying every uncertain immaterial or supernatural possibility, so that stronger universal claim needs separate support.
con-known-world-not-universal-negative.critique: Strongest feature: The move precisely distinguishes acceptance of the publicly known physical world from the substantially stronger universal denial of every immaterial possibility, while explicitly preserving uncertainty about undefined alternatives. Principal limitation: Its burden analysis understates that metaphysical naturalism may itself affirm nature as exhaustive, a formulation requiring positive support rather than merely withholding assent from supernatural additions. Live burden: The evidence-centered position must consistently identify whether it defends methodological reliance, provisional ontology, or metaphysical exclusivity, because movement among those formulations changes the proposition under examination and the corresponding justificatory obligation. Locked score: The supplied very strong band reflects exceptional conceptual clarity, qualification, and coherence alongside incomplete engagement with the strongest affirmative definition available to the opposing case.

pro-metaphysical-naturalism-positive-bur.words: Metaphysical naturalism says only natural reality exists; because that is an affirmative worldview claim, its defender cannot disclaim every burden in this debate.
pro-metaphysical-naturalism-positive-bur.critique: Strongest feature: The reply directly answers the definitional maneuver by distinguishing supernaturalism as nature plus something further and explaining why metaphysical naturalism's exclusivity carries an affirmative justificatory burden. Principal limitation: It compresses the unresolved question whether the opponent actually defends exhaustive metaphysical naturalism or only provisional acceptance of the known natural world, making its burden assignment somewhat definition-dependent. Live burden: The cognitive-reliability critique must establish that the debated formulation genuinely includes ontological exclusivity and then demonstrate why available natural evidence inadequately supports that proposition, rather than treating the debate title alone as determinative. Locked score: The supplied very strong band recognizes unusually complete responsiveness, stable terminology, and coherent burden contact while preserving the material qualification that the governing definition remains contested.

pro-nonrational-physical-belief-producti.words: If beliefs are wholly produced by law-governed physical processes rather than truth-directed commitments, naturalism appears unable to warrant confidence that those beliefs rationally track truth.
pro-nonrational-physical-belief-producti.critique: Strongest feature: The move clearly isolates the causal-production premise of the self-defeat route by contrasting neural mechanisms governed by natural laws with belief formation responsive to rational grounds and truth. Principal limitation: It treats physical realization and rational responsiveness as contrasting categories without demonstrating incompatibility, overlooking the possibility that organized neural processes implement evidence-sensitive inference through their causal architecture. Live burden: The critique must explain why semantic content, evidential sensitivity, or valid inference cannot exercise an appropriate causal role within physical cognition, instead of relying upon descriptions such as particles, reactions, or mechanical processes. Locked score: The supplied mixed band reflects high central relevance and recoverable structure but materially limited warrant, charity, and conceptual development at the argument's indispensable compatibility premise.

pro-selection-fitness-truth-gap.words: Selection directly favors survival and reproduction, not abstract truth, leaving an unresolved warrant gap when evolved faculties address theology, ethics, epistemology, or metaphysics.
pro-selection-fitness-truth-gap.critique: Strongest feature: The move identifies the debate's central domain-extension problem by contrasting faculties selected for practical survival with confidence in abstract theological, ethical, epistemological, and metaphysical conclusions. Principal limitation: Selection's failure to target truth directly does not establish that adaptive cognition has almost no reliability, because accurate representation, cultural learning, and institutional correction may indirectly connect fitness with truth. Live burden: The critique must estimate how far those indirect connections extend, identify which abstract domains exceed them, and show why public checking cannot adequately repair the resulting uncertainty without presupposing the reliability under dispute. Locked score: The supplied strong and competent band reflects outstanding relevance and a genuine explanatory gap while retaining substantial reservations about overstatement, evidential support, and insufficient engagement with indirect truth-tracking mechanisms.

con-social-selection-dependable-cognitio.words: Social evolution favored empathy, cooperation, trustworthiness, and dependable partners, giving selection a practical reason to preserve some reliable interpersonal cognition.
con-social-selection-dependable-cognitio.critique: Strongest feature: The reply supplies an intelligible evolutionary reason for preserving dependable social dispositions by connecting empathy, cooperation, trustworthiness, and reliable partnership with differential success across generations. Principal limitation: Practical interpersonal dependability does not establish reliability concerning comprehensive metaphysical propositions, and the move never constructs the necessary bridge from successful cooperation to abstract truth-sensitive cognition. Live burden: The evidence-centered defense must explain how locally adaptive representational capacities combine with language, criticism, measurement, and cumulative institutions to support conclusions outside immediate social environments, while acknowledging remaining domain-specific error. Locked score: The supplied strong and competent band appropriately reflects relevant contact, coherent social explanation, and charitable engagement alongside partial responsiveness, limited evidence, and an unresolved extension to worldview-level reliability.

pro-cooperation-does-not-entail-cosmic-t.words: Explaining empathy and cooperative herd behavior does not establish that human cognitive faculties reliably discover comprehensive truths about the universe or grand worldviews.
pro-cooperation-does-not-entail-cosmic-t.critique: Strongest feature: The reply precisely diagnoses the opponent's missing domain-extension inference, distinguishing adaptive empathy and cooperative dependability from the considerably stronger capacity to discover comprehensive truths about the universe. Principal limitation: Saying cooperation provides no basis at all understates its possible indirect contribution, since socially distributed criticism, testimony, and coordination can become components of broader truth-correcting practices. Live burden: The critique must show that even supplemented social cognition cannot justify the relevant metaphysical extension, specifying where experimental, mathematical, or institutional correction loses traction rather than demanding direct evolutionary selection for every abstract proposition. Locked score: The supplied very strong band reflects exceptional responsiveness, conceptual stability, and successful diagnosis of nonentailment, tempered only by an overstated dismissal of cooperation's indirect epistemic relevance.

pro-determinism-epiphenomenalism-defeate.words: Deterministic production and causally idle mental states could each defeat worldview confidence if conclusions arise independently of rational content rather than because of it.
pro-determinism-epiphenomenalism-defeate.critique: Strongest feature: The move broadens the causal challenge by separating deterministic production from epiphenomenal mental content and illustrating causal idleness through the memorable comparison between a train and its whistle. Principal limitation: The examples establish conditional defeaters only for naturalist accounts that accept the relevant determinism or epiphenomenalism, while many accounts understand reasoning as causally realized rather than causally irrelevant. Live burden: The critique must identify which commitments follow from evolutionary naturalism generally, distinguish conditional targets carefully, and explain why emergent or realized mental content cannot guide conclusions through physically implemented inferential organization. Locked score: The supplied mixed band reflects a relevant and potentially important family of objections, but also its nonanswer to the selected social-evolution target, limited scope, and insufficiently defended generalization.

pro-natural-reinterpretation-insulation.words: If every apparent divine manifestation is automatically redescribed as aliens or another natural cause, naturalism becomes insulated from contrary observational evidence.
pro-natural-reinterpretation-insulation.critique: Strongest feature: The move poses a concrete disconfirmation test by asking whether even striking apparent manifestations of divine agency would automatically receive an alien or otherwise natural reinterpretation. Principal limitation: Hypothetical reactions attributed to some naturalists do not establish that naturalism generally excludes supernatural explanations, because comparative preference for a natural explanation may reflect evidential assessment rather than prior insulation. Live burden: The challenge must specify an observational pattern whose likelihood differs meaningfully between rival hypotheses and show that naturalists would reject the better-supported explanation solely because of its classification, not because agency identification remains underdetermined. Locked score: The supplied mixed band reflects a clear, relevant falsifiability concern with proportionate conditional force, while retaining substantial reservations about target generalization, evidential specificity, and limited direct responsiveness.

con-additional-supernatural-burden.words: Because both sides accept the natural world, anyone adding a supernatural realm must justify that addition through independent, repeatable, objective verification.
con-additional-supernatural-burden.critique: Strongest feature: The reply grounds a distinct burden in the proposed addition of supernatural reality to the shared natural world and supplies independent, repeatable, objective verification as an intelligible evidential criterion. Principal limitation: That additional burden does not settle whether an affirmative metaphysical naturalist also owes support for claiming that nature exhausts reality, so the argument cannot independently resolve the definitional dispute. Live burden: The evidence-centered position must defend its verification standard without assuming that only directly measurable entities are evidentially admissible, while distinguishing evidence for unexplained effects from evidence identifying a specifically supernatural cause. Locked score: The supplied very strong band reflects exceptional responsiveness, precision, coherence, and calibration, with the limited reservation that reciprocal burdens remain possible under the stronger metaphysical formulation.

pro-personal-debunking-limited-scope.words: Failed supernatural claims within one person's experience cannot settle every reported miracle, particularly when the debate independently questions that evaluator's cognitive reliability.
pro-personal-debunking-limited-scope.critique: Strongest feature: The reply correctly limits extrapolation from one person's encounters with failed supernatural claims and reconnects the evaluation of those encounters to the debate's broader dispute about cognitive reliability. Principal limitation: Its omniscience language exaggerates the opponent's position, because repeated investigative failures can justify provisional skepticism without purporting to survey or conclusively dismiss every reported miracle. Live burden: The critique must identify credible unexamined cases, explain why their documentation survives ordinary alternative explanations, and show that the opponent's prior is excessively restrictive rather than merely informed by accumulated disconfirmation. Locked score: The supplied strong and competent band reflects direct contact with an evidential overgeneralization and an important scope qualification, balanced against broad terminology, rhetorical overstatement, and limited affirmative evidence for the wider reports invoked.

con-repeated-testing-and-disconfirmation.words: Repeated objectively corroborated failures justify provisional naturalism, while verified supernatural evidence remains an explicit condition that would require revising that conclusion.
con-repeated-testing-and-disconfirmation.critique: Strongest feature: The reply rejects the omniscience characterization, appeals to repeatedly corroborated investigative experience, and states an explicit condition under which verified supernatural evidence would change the speaker's conclusion. Principal limitation: The assertion that supernatural claims have never been verified extends beyond the unspecified collection of tests described, leaving the breadth and representativeness of the evidential sample insufficiently established. Live burden: The defense must articulate standards for successful verification, apply them consistently to disputed cases, and explain how repeated failures update confidence without converting a defensible provisional inference into an unrestricted historical universal. Locked score: The supplied very strong band reflects exceptional responsiveness, revisability, and evidential orientation while preserving a material qualification concerning the scope of the empirical record invoked.

pro-internal-defeat-without-alternative-.words: Naturalism may warrant withheld confidence without proving supernaturalism if nonrational causation and survival-oriented cognition make its own affirmation internally incoherent.
pro-internal-defeat-without-alternative-.critique: Strongest feature: The reply accurately distinguishes internal defeat from establishing a supernatural alternative, explaining why an allegedly self-undermining worldview cannot answer the objection merely by demanding independent proof of something beyond nature. Principal limitation: Its claim that evolved faculties have no legitimate application beyond survival remains too broad, because indirect truth-tracking, cultural accumulation, and corrigible inquiry might extend cognition without requiring selection specifically for metaphysics. Live burden: The critique must complete its internal case by defeating those extension mechanisms and establishing that the relevant naturalist commitments actually entail unreliable worldview cognition, rather than only raising a conditional possibility. Locked score: The supplied strong and competent band reflects excellent diagnostic responsiveness and clear burden placement while retaining important reservations about the unresolved causal and evolutionary premises.

con-provisional-sensory-reliance.words: Humans must provisionally rely on sensory experience as reality, while any claimed exception to the natural world still requires supporting evidence.
con-provisional-sensory-reliance.critique: Strongest feature: The reply offers a modest operational starting point by treating sensory experience as provisionally trustworthy and preserving an evidential burden for claimed exceptions to the known natural world. Principal limitation: Practical unavoidability does not answer the internal question of rational warrant, and the passage shifts insufficiently clearly between provisional acceptance of known nature and exclusive metaphysical naturalism. Live burden: The defense must explain why unavoidable reliance becomes epistemically responsible reliance through calibration, predictive success, cross-checking, and error correction, then show how those resources support abstract conclusions rather than perception alone. Locked score: The supplied strong and competent band reflects a clear, appropriately qualified baseline and relevant burden contact, tempered by partial responsiveness and failure to resolve the central domain-extension challenge.

con-objective-data-over-experience.words: Publicly verifiable data should govern contested beliefs because personal cognition and authority are fallible, although experience may still provide defeasible preliminary evidence.
con-objective-data-over-experience.critique: Strongest feature: The reply acknowledges both speakers' fallibility and identifies publicly accessible, independently verifiable data as the corrective standard for claims that cannot responsibly rest on authority or private experience. Principal limitation: Describing personal experiences as meaningless is unnecessarily broad, since experiences can supply defeasible evidence even when they remain inadequate for publicly contested supernatural conclusions without corroboration. Live burden: The evidence-centered position must explain how objective practices arise from individually fallible observers, specify safeguards against shared systematic error, and demonstrate how correction extends from measurable cases to the broader naturalistic worldview. Locked score: The supplied strong and competent band reflects direct responsiveness, sound evidential priority, and constructive correction, while preserving reservations about rhetorical overstatement and the incompletely defended reach of public verification.

pro-supernatural-causes-natural-effects.words: Although supernatural causes may resist direct measurement, they could produce observable natural effects whose documented patterns permit comparative causal evaluation, as with an apparent healing.
pro-supernatural-causes-natural-effects.critique: Strongest feature: The reply clearly distinguishes an unmeasured supernatural cause from its potentially observable natural effects and thereby offers an intelligible evidential route rather than demanding acceptance without publicly accessible consequences. Principal limitation: An unexplained recovery does not identify supernatural agency, because spontaneous remission, diagnostic error, treatment effects, and unknown natural mechanisms remain competing explanations requiring comparative evaluation. Live burden: The proposal must supply independently authenticated documentation, antecedently specified expectations, meaningful controls, and a pattern substantially more probable under a particular supernatural hypothesis than under available natural alternatives. Locked score: The supplied very strong band reflects exceptional responsiveness, conceptual consistency, explicit uncertainty, and a legitimate possible evidential pathway while retaining significant reservations about causal identification and undeveloped supporting evidence.

pro-correction-limited-beyond-verificati.words: Correcting measurable cognitive errors collaboratively does not itself warrant confidence that survival-shaped faculties remain reliable for naturalistic conclusions extending beyond verification.
pro-correction-limited-beyond-verificati.critique: Strongest feature: The reply identifies the precise scope transition requiring defense, explaining that success in correcting measurable errors does not automatically warrant comprehensive confidence beyond the domains where correction operates. Principal limitation: It leaves unspecified which naturalistic conclusions are genuinely beyond indirect empirical constraint, and therefore does not establish that scientific or philosophical checking necessarily ends at the disputed boundary. Live burden: The critique must classify the relevant propositions, distinguish direct verification from probabilistic constraint, and demonstrate why convergent evidence, prediction, coherence, and adversarial criticism cannot supply proportionate confidence across those categories. Locked score: The supplied strong and competent band reflects excellent diagnostic responsiveness, coherent scope analysis, and careful calibration, balanced against limited examples and an underdeveloped account of verification's actual boundaries.

con-consider-documented-healing.words: A documented apparent healing merits examination rather than dismissal, although earlier citation failures can justify a skeptical expectation pending review of the new evidence.
con-consider-documented-healing.critique: Strongest feature: The reply expressly refuses automatic dismissal, states that adequate documentation would require consideration, and carefully presents skepticism from earlier citation failures as a revisable expectation rather than a foreclosed conclusion. Principal limitation: Willingness to consider documentation is procedurally valuable but does not specify the evidential thresholds needed to distinguish unexplained recovery, inaccurate reporting, and genuinely supernatural causation. Live burden: The defense must examine the proposed records consistently, identify what they establish at each inferential stage, and allow sufficiently discriminating evidence to update both natural and supernatural hypotheses without classification-based shortcuts. Locked score: The supplied very strong band reflects exceptional responsiveness, charity, qualification, and openness to revision while preserving the unresolved substantive task of evaluating documentation and identifying causation.

con-dispute-determinism-rationality-link.words: The critique's descriptions of determinism and rationality do not match the defended naturalist account, so their alleged incompatibility requires considerably more argument.
con-dispute-determinism-rationality-link.critique: Strongest feature: The reply identifies a potentially decisive premise dispute by denying that the defended naturalist account entails strict determinism or accepts the opponent's descriptions of determinism and rationality. Principal limitation: It mainly asserts disagreement without defining an alternative account of rational physical causation, and it insufficiently distinguishes strict determinism from the opponent's separate conditional epiphenomenal and causal-responsiveness challenges. Live burden: The defense must explain how reasons and semantic content participate in physically realized inference, then answer each defeater independently rather than treating denial of deterministic reality as a comprehensive response. Locked score: The supplied mixed band reflects substantial relevance and appropriately modest force, but also partial recoverability, limited evidence, compressed representation, and an underdeveloped answer to the central mechanism.

strengths: Clearly distinguished an internal critique of naturalism from the separate task of proving supernaturalism.
Exposed the unsupported transition from adaptive social cooperation to reliability about comprehensive worldview questions.
Maintained pressure on the scope of public correction by asking how locally testable success warrants broader metaphysical confidence.
Offered a coherent evidential route whereby alleged supernatural causes could be assessed through observable natural effects.

blunders.text: The physical-causation argument treated neural realization and rational responsiveness as incompatible without establishing that crucial premise.
The fitness argument sometimes moved from selection not directly targeting truth to an excessively broad absence of cognitive warrant.
The falsifiability challenge generalized hypothetical reinterpretations by some naturalists without demonstrating systematic evidential insulation.

strengths: Distinguished provisional acceptance of the known physical world from an unsupported universal denial of every immaterial possibility.
Grounded the burden for supernatural additions in independent, repeatable, objective verification.
Presented sensory reliance and naturalistic conclusions as provisional and corrigible rather than certain.
Specified contrary documentation as relevant evidence and expressly allowed that adequate verification would require reconsideration.

blunders.text: The social-evolution reply explained interpersonal dependability but never bridged that capacity to abstract metaphysical reliability.
The appeal to unavoidable sensory reliance did not fully answer the challenge concerning rational warrant for worldview-level conclusions.
The late rejection of determinism remained largely assertive and supplied no developed account of physically realized rational causation.

newArguments.title: Calibration-transfer argument
newArguments.text: Reliability established in one domain transfers only when the target domain preserves relevant feedback, error signals, and correction mechanisms. Perception and engineering offer dense feedback, while comprehensive metaphysical claims may generate fewer discriminating predictions. The pro case can therefore ask for a transfer function: which features of successful empirical inquiry remain available, which disappear, and how confidence is adjusted accordingly. This approach concedes extensive naturalistic knowledge while challenging any uncalibrated passage from practical success to exhaustive ontology.

novelty.explanation: The transcript did not formulate reliability as a transfer problem governed by feedback structure and confidence calibration.

newArguments.title: Causal sensitivity test
newArguments.text: A belief-forming process is rationally significant when changing the evidence or inferential relations would appropriately change the resulting belief. The pro side can test naturalist accounts against this counterfactual standard instead of contrasting truth with physics in the abstract. If semantic differences make no causal difference, the defeater gains force; if physically realized systems reliably respond to those differences, the objection weakens. This creates a discriminating criterion and avoids assuming that physical implementation alone excludes reasoning.

novelty.explanation: This supplies the missing mechanism-level criterion for the participant's causal challenge.

newArguments.title: Triangulated independence argument
newArguments.text: Global defeat is weakened when reliability is supported by checks that fail in different ways. Human perception, calibrated instruments, mathematical constraints, independent observers, and successful intervention are not perfectly independent, but their error structures only partly overlap. Agreement across them is therefore more informative than repeated reliance on a single faculty. The con side can defend naturalistic inquiry through this triangulation while conceding residual fallibility and requiring narrower confidence wherever the checks become less independent or less discriminating.

novelty.explanation: The transcript appealed to objective data but did not develop partially independent error structures as an answer to global defeat.

newArguments.title: Symmetric model comparison
newArguments.text: The evidential standard should compare specified models rather than classify explanations as natural or supernatural before examination. A healing claim, for example, should state expected timing, diagnosis, treatment history, documentation quality, and what the proposed agency predicts beyond spontaneous recovery or error. Naturalism is favored when natural models predict the record better, but a sufficiently specific alternative may outperform them. This symmetry answers the insulation concern while preventing an unexplained event from being treated immediately as positive identification of supernatural causation.

novelty.explanation: The transcript discussed documentation and natural effects but did not articulate symmetric predictive model comparison.
